name: Sigmoid Panel Modeling
definition: A differentiable model for detector panel performance using a pair of double-sigmoid functions in x and y. The values provide resolutions in xy, and their product provides hit efficiency. This allows hits and muon trajectories to be differentiable with respect to all panel parameters.
summary: Sigmoid Panel Modeling is a differentiable detector hit-recording method that replaces binary step functions with smooth sigmoid transitions to enable gradient-based optimization of muon tomography detector geometry.
